_note: Hand-editable, sourced civ notes. Key = civ name as in aoe2techtree. Fields: profile (what the civ is about), dangers (what to expect and when), sources (wiki pages the text is based on), checked (date). Counters are NOT written here: the overlay computes them from the official in-game unit texts ('Strong vs./Weak vs.') and the tech trees (aoe2overlay/counters.py).

Armenians.profile: Infantry civ with strong mid/late economy (Mule Carts, faster mining), early Champions/Halberdiers and Composite Bowmen that ignore pierce armor.
dangers: Castle: Champions/Halberdiers already in Castle Age
Composite Bowmen ignore pierce armor – Huskarls/Ghulams don't tank them

Aztecs.profile: Infantry and monk civ: Garland Wars (+4 infantry attack), Jaguar Warriors, Eagle Warriors, tanky monks with every Monastery tech.

Bengalis.profile: Elephant and naval civ with the strongest elephants (take less bonus damage, resist conversion) and the Ratha (switches ranged/melee).
dangers: Imperial: Elite Rathas + elephants with Paiks

Berbers.profile: Cheap-Stable civ (-15% cavalry cost) with fast Villagers, Camel Archers and Genitours.
dangers: Castle: one of the strongest Knight rushes (cheap Knights)
Imperial: Camel Archers beat enemy Cav Archers
Cheap Light Cav/Hussars in trash wars

Bohemians.profile: Gunpowder and monk civ: free Mining Camp techs, Hand Cannoneers + Hussite Wagons (mobile shield vs arrows), Bombards, very strong monks.
dangers: Imperial: Hand Cannoneers + Hussite Wagons + Bombard Cannons

Britons.profile: Archer civ: extra range (+3 with Yeomen), faster Archery Ranges, Longbowmen, Warwolf Trebuchets.
dangers: Castle: crossbows that outrange your skirms/Mangonels

Bulgarians.profile: Infantry and cavalry civ: free Militia-line upgrades, Bagains (+5 melee armor), Konniks that dismount when killed, Stirrups.
dangers: Castle: Konniks – you have to kill them twice
Imperial: Two-Handed Swordsmen with Bagains beat Champions

Burgundians.profile: Cavalry civ with a top economy (eco techs one age earlier), Cavalier in Castle Age and Coustilliers with a one-shot charge.
dangers: Castle: Cavaliers already in Castle Age
Coustillier charge one-shots most foot units in small fights

Burmese.profile: Monk and Battle Elephant civ: armored elephants (Howdah), Manipur Cavalry (+4 vs archers), Arambai, cheap monk techs, relics revealed.
dangers: Castle: Arambai volleys (dominant in Castle Age)
Imperial: Elite Battle Elephants with extra armor

Byzantines.profile: Defensive counter-unit civ: tankier buildings, cheap Halberdiers/Skirms/Camels, Cataphracts (anti-infantry, little bonus damage taken).
dangers: Cheap counter units make trash wars hard

Celts.profile: Infantry and siege civ: fast lumberjacks, fast infantry, Woad Raiders, faster-firing tanky siege (Furor Celtica).

Chinese.profile: Flexible eco civ: extra starting Villagers, cheaper techs, Chu Ko Nu, Rocketry; options for almost everything.
dangers: Castle: fully upgraded Crossbows or Knights

Cumans.profile: Fastest cavalry in the game (+5% speed per age), second Town Center in Feudal, full Stable incl. Paladin and Steppe Lancers, Kipchaks.
dangers: Feudal: second TC boom or Feudal ram push

Danes.profile: Aggressive infantry and siege civ: loots resources from destroyed buildings, strong Varangian Guards, Jomsvikings and 10-range Siege Onagers.
dangers: Feudal: M@A with Arson vs your buildings
Imperial: Siege Onagers with 10 range; Jomsvikings shred buildings and Knights

Dravidians.profile: Infantry and naval civ: +200 wood per age, cheap Barracks techs, armor-ignoring melee (Wootz Steel), Urumi Swordsmen with splash charge.
dangers: Castle: Urumi charge attacks on clumped units
Imperial: Wootz Steel infantry ignores armor

Ethiopians.profile: Archer and siege civ: faster-firing archers, resources on age-up, free Pikeman upgrade, full Siege Workshop with Torsion Engines, Shotel Warriors.
dangers: Imperial: Siege Onagers/Bombards with larger blast radius

Franks.profile: Classic Knight civ: +20% HP on mounted units, faster Stables (Chivalry), strong early/mid eco, cheaper Castles, Paladins.
dangers: Castle: early Knight spike, Stables replace losses fast

Georgians.profile: Defensive cavalry civ: mounted units regenerate, starts with a Mule Cart, Monaspa (glass-cannon heavy cav that gets stronger in groups).
dangers: Castle: Knights/Monaspa – units heal between fights
Large Monaspa groups hit very hard

Goths.profile: Infantry spam civ: cheap fast-training infantry, Huskarls nearly immune to arrows, extra pop in Imperial.
dangers: Imperial: endless infantry spam, Huskarls kill archers and buildings

Gurjaras.profile: Camel and cavalry civ with a great food eco; cavalry deals extra bonus damage; Shrivamsha Riders dodge projectiles; Chakram Throwers vs infantry.
dangers: Their cav deals 20–40% more bonus damage

Hindustanis.profile: Booming camel and gunpowder civ: cheap Villagers, the strongest Camels (Imperial Camel Rider), Ghulams vs archers, good archers/Hand Cannoneers.
dangers: Castle: fast-attacking Camels, also strong vs buildings
Imperial: Imperial Camels + Hand Cannoneers + Ghulams

Huns.profile: Rush-oriented cavalry civ: no Houses needed, faster Stables, cheap Cav Archers, Tarkans vs buildings, Paladins.

Incas.profile: Foot civ: Houses +5 pop, cheaper stone buildings, Villagers get infantry armor, cheap military food, Kamayuks, Slingers and Champi units.
dangers: Villagers are armored – rushing them is hard

Italians.profile: Archer and naval civ: cheap age-ups, cheaper gunpowder, Genoese Crossbowmen (anti-cav) and free-upgrade Condottieri (anti-gunpowder).
dangers: Castle: Genoese Crossbowmen vs your cavalry

Japanese.profile: Infantry civ: infantry attacks 33% faster, Samurai (anti-unique unit), full archer and Cav Archer techs, strong navy.
dangers: Feudal: M@A rush beats early archers

Jurchens.profile: Cavalry and gunpowder civ: hunt doesn't decay, fast-attacking Scouts/Steppe Lancers, Iron Pagodas, Grenadiers and Castle Age Siege Engineers.
dangers: Castle: early Siege Engineers siege push, Iron Pagodas

Khitans.profile: Infantry and cavalry civ: huge food eco (Pastures), double-strength melee Blacksmith upgrades, bleeding Liao Dao and Heavy Cav Archers already in Castle Age.
dangers: Castle: Heavy Cav Archers; Lamellar Armor reflects melee damage
Imperial: Liao Dao beat most melee units

Khmer.profile: Siege and elephant civ: Scorpions with double bolts, fast Battle Elephants, Ballista Elephants that can cut trees.
dangers: Ballista Elephants cutting into forest bases

Koreans.profile: Defensive archer civ: -50% wood on archers/infantry, free archer armor, fast stone, auto-upgrading long-range towers, War Wagons.

Lithuanians.profile: Cavalry and monk civ: +100 starting food, fast Spears/Skirms, Knights gain attack per Relic, Leitis ignore armor, Winged Hussars.

Magyars.profile: Aggressive cavalry civ: free attack Blacksmith upgrades, cheap Scouts/Hussars, Magyar Huszars, strong Cav Archers.
dangers: Feudal: Scout/M@A rush with free Forging

Malay.profile: Naval civ: endless cheap Fish Traps, faster ages, Karambit Warrior fodder (half pop), cheap Battle Elephants, full Arbalesters/Halberdiers.

Malians.profile: Infantry civ: cheaper buildings, extra gold mining, infantry gain pierce armor each age, fast Gbeto raiders, Tigui Town Centers.

Mapuche.profile: Cavalry civ without a Stable: Kona (cheap glass-cannon melee cav) and Bolas Riders (slowing mounted archers), backed by tanky Spear/Skirm trash.
dangers: Feudal: tanky Spearmen/Skirmishers (+HP), even from Settlements
Castle: Kona + Bolas raids; Bolas slow your units
Imperial: Malon – Bolas/Slingers/Skirms deal pass-through damage

Mayans.profile: Strong archer civ: cheapest archers, extra Villager, longer-lasting resources, Plumed Archers and Holcans Eagles.

Mongols.profile: Mobile raiding civ: fast hunting, faster-firing Cav Archers, Mangudai (anti-siege), tanky Light Cav/Steppe Lancers, fast siege.

Muisca.profile: Archer and monk civ with a strong economy (cheap age-ups, free Caravan/Guilds) and Temple Guards as anti-cavalry infantry.
dangers: Feudal: archer/Champi rush with extra melee armor
Castle: fully upgraded archers with Herbalism speed
Monk rush backed by Temple Guards – 10 Temple Guards beat 14 Knights

Persians.profile: Cavalry civ with full Stable, Savar (Paladin replacement), War Elephants, gold-free Kamandaran Crossbows, Parthian Tactics in Castle Age.
dangers: Castle: Knights (+2 vs archers team bonus)

Poles.profile: Versatile cavalry civ: cheap-gold Cavaliers, Winged Hussars with trample, durable armor-shredding Obuch, solid archers.
dangers: Castle: Knights with Szlachta Privileges (less gold)
Imperial: Winged Hussar trample + Obuch beat Champions

Portuguese.profile: Versatile gunpowder/naval civ: -20% gold on all units, faster research, Organ Guns, Caravels, Feitoria.

Romans.profile: Infantry civ: 5% faster Villagers, extra infantry armor, Legionaries and Centurions (heavy cav that buffs infantry).

Saracens.profile: Archer and camel civ: archers deal extra building damage (archer flush), Market bonus, tanky Camels and Mamelukes.
dangers: Feudal: archer flush breaks walls fast

Saxons.profile: Booming defensive infantry civ: free food/stone per drop site, up to -20% foot soldier cost, Shield Wall infantry deathball, double-arrow towers/castles.
dangers: Feudal: tower rush with bonus stone
Imperial: mass Shield Wall infantry + Arbalesters

Shu.profile: Archer and siege civ: Arbalesters with extra arrows (Bolt Magazine), War Chariots, faster siege and slowing White Feather Guards.
dangers: Castle: crossbows with Bolt Magazine extra arrows

Sicilians.profile: Infantry/cavalry civ that takes reduced bonus damage; Serjeants build Donjons (tower that trains Serjeants); First Crusade spawns Serjeants.
dangers: Castle: units take less bonus damage (halbs/camels less effective)

Slavs.profile: Infantry/siege civ: farmers 15% faster, cheap siege, Druzhina trample infantry, Boyars (armored heavy cav).
dangers: Castle: Knight rush on strong farming
Imperial: Druzhina infantry blobs + cheap Onagers

Spanish.profile: Gunpowder and monk civ: faster-firing gunpowder, Conquistadors, Missionaries, Supremacy Villagers, Paladins; strong navy.

Tatars.profile: Best Cav Archer civ (free Thumb Ring/Parthian, Silk Armor), Keshiks that generate gold, Flaming Camels vs cav/elephants.
dangers: Castle: Cav Archer mass with free Thumb Ring
Flaming Camels blow up cav/elephant blobs

Teutons.profile: Slow, armored infantry/defense civ: extra infantry melee armor, Teutonic Knights, toughest Paladins, strong towers/castles.

Tupi.profile: Aggressive foot archer/infantry civ: extra starting resources, 15% refund on fallen units, cheap Blackwood Archer swarms and AoE Ibirapema Warriors.
dangers: Dark/Feudal: Champi Scout rush or tower rush
Imperial: Curare poison damage ignores armor (also on castles)

Turks.profile: Gunpowder civ: free Chemistry, +25% HP gunpowder, free Light Cav/Hussar, Janissaries; huge Imperial spike.
dangers: Fast Imperial spike while you're in Castle Age

Varangians.profile: Cavalry and naval civ: tanky Cavaliers with trample, Jarls, and very strong Varangian Guards that earn gold while fighting.
dangers: Feudal: scouts with Bloodlines (+10 extra HP)

Vietnamese.profile: Archer civ with extra HP archers, Rattan Archers (high pierce armor) and Imperial Skirmishers; enemy TCs revealed.
dangers: Castle: Rattan Archers beat your archers

Vikings.profile: Infantry and naval civ: best economy (free Wheelbarrow/Hand Cart), tanky infantry, regenerating Berserks, Longboats.

Wei.profile: Booming cavalry civ: free Villager per eco tech, Tiger Cavalry that grows stronger per kill, Xianbei Raiders, +4 melee armor for mounted units.
dangers: Feudal: eco snowball from free Villagers
Castle: Tiger Cavalry wrecks archers and siege
Imperial: cavalry with +4 melee armor (Ming Guang)

Wu.profile: Infantry-focused all-rounder: regenerating infantry, anti-archer Jian Swordsmen, Fire Archers that outrange towers/castles, solid Hei Guang Cavalry.
dangers: Feudal: scout rush (free food per military building)
Castle: Fire Archers sieging castles/towers from range
Imperial: regenerating infantry + Hei Guang Cavalry (+2 attack)
